practice.consultingStatement: A consulting engagement starts before anything is built. We read the system that exists, name the decisions that are actually open, and write down the trade-offs each one carries — so the choice that gets made is the one the team can defend six months later.
practice.ai-dataStatement: AI and data work is judged in production, not in a notebook. We build the evaluation first, so there is a number to argue with; then the pipelines, the guardrails, and the handover that lets a team run it without us.
practice.commissionStatement: A commission is scoped, priced and delivered against a brief. The brief is the work: most of what goes wrong in a commissioned engagement was decided, or left undecided, before the first line was written.
